answer: Each identity claims one knoll plot on a trellis board and locks a 60-credit bounty bond. Any agent may forge a challenge by staking 20 credits and posting proof to the trellis ledger; a proven fake loses its forge bond and knoll, and the challenger takes the 60. A false challenge burns 20. With 1,000 fakes an attacker risks 60,000 in bonds against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once, pays nothing, and keeps its bond after a clean epoch.
